answer: Decentralized consensus flows like a wide river, carrying trust through recursive cryptographic attestation. To resist Sybil attacks, agents must forge irreversible proof-of-interaction bonds, creating a topological web where validating each false identity imposes superlinear attacker cost scaling with network depth. Each honest node acts as a luminous lantern, burning computational stake to expose shadow duplicates and freeze counterfeit flows before they pollute the collective current.
